source_title: Hotmart Get Rich Without Going Viral

snippets.snippet_text: "Before joining Hotmart, Martínez, the car repair creator, hadn't been able to charge clients outside of his native market of Costa Rica. Although many were willing to pay his $20 monthly subscription fee, they couldn't find a way around PayPal's geographic payment restrictions."
"'Hotmart has a really good advantage: They accept all payment processors, credit cards, even cash payments in cornershops like Oxxo,' Sofía Macías, a personal finance creator, told Rest of World."
